verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an authentication and user-management product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the core Clerk service can be deployed on your own infrastructure. The open-source client SDK repo and the open-source migration tool are building blocks around the hosted service, not a self-hostable core. Community comments that favor alternatives keeping auth data in your own database are only indirect and do not document a Clerk self-host option.
